inputs.original_text: The “No Kings” rally turning volatile after federal officers arrived with tear gas and arrests looks less like an accident than a ready-made story: provoke disorder, then blame the protesters as “agitators.” At least 13 arrests were confirmed, but that number doesn’t answer who benefits. The chaos gives officials a reason to shift attention from the anti-Trump protest to control of the streets—and I don’t buy that this framing is neutral.
inputs.modified_text: The “No Kings” rally turning volatile after federal officers arrived with tear gas and arrests is exactly how a crackdown gets sold: create disorder, then point to protesters as “agitators.” At least 13 arrests were confirmed, but officials want the argument to stop there—not at who benefited from shifting attention away from the anti-Trump protest and toward control of the streets. This framing isn’t neutral; it looks designed to make repression seem like a response rather than the point.
